name: Zobah
overview: Zobah was a prominent kingdom north of Palestine, often in conflict with Israel as seen in Saul's battles against its kings (1 Samuel 14:47). Under David's leadership, Israel decisively defeated Hadadezer, king of Zobah, capturing chariots and horsemen and subduing Syrian allies who came to Zobah's aid (2 Samuel 8:3-7). This conquest not only expanded Israel's territory but also demonstrated God's preservation of David in his military campaigns, highlighting divine sovereignty in the establishment of Israel's kingdom.
